title: What It's Like To Stay At This $4 Million Mega Airbnb In Spain
description:
Silverfield Villa in Granada, Spain is a mega Airbnb overlooking the Sierra Nevada Mountains. The six-floor house has a glass elevator, game room, spa, cross-fit rig, two gyms, two pool and seven bedrooms. Videographer Ryan Doyle of Video Vision 360 explores this villa built for fitness retreats.
